comment: Component kit defaults (docs/design/04 §1, 08 §10). 'art.include' lists the assets/registry.json id prefixes the UI art catalog preloads (Cli.BuildUiArt); screens name backgrounds by registry id in ui/screens.json. 'meter.kinds' are the Meter kinds (each becomes the USS class meter--<kind>). 'handFan': degrees between neighbouring cards, the widest total spread, and the card count after which the hand scrolls. 'tooltip.sizes' are WT0-WT3 (USS class tooltip--<size>). 'boot.filesPerFrame' paces the determinate boot bar over the manifest. 'card.costKinds' are the cost pips in order (actions, stamina, mana).
